title: More Withers
description: This mod adds more withers to Minecraft
body:
This mod adds many withers to Minecraft, divided into many different types.They also have corresponding abilities.For example, the Fire Wither's wither skulls will set the ground on fire, the Ice Wither's wither skulls will create ice blocks.Among these withers, There are some completely optional bosses that are not tied to the main storyline—SuperBoss

There are two items in the mod—Titan Sword and Element Rod.Titan Sword is a very powerful weapon. Both left-click and right-click perform area-of-effect attacks.Element Rod is a drop from Avatar Wither. Holding it and right-clicking on any of these withers will activate their Raid Mode
